Description:
This is your chance to have it all! Centre stage in the Yaletown Marina/ Beach Crescent neighbourhood at the Westone, the essence of living well. This highly sought after 01 floor plan with sweeping views of the city, Granville Island & False Creek comes with a large balcony.

Enjoying the spacious open kitchen/dining/living areas, two bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The home exquisitely finished with Hardwood flooring in all living areas, double edged granite to stainless steel appliances.

Floor to ceiling glass walls celebrate the natural environment. Features include 24 hour concierge.

As a resident at Westone, you get to enjoy membership at Club Viva, a resort-style facility that includes lap pool, jacuzzi, steam room, guest suite, theatre, TV lounge, spa, squash courts, pool lounge, ping pong table, party room with a full kitchen, outdoor patio with BBQ, and much more.

Minutes walking distance to Yaletown Roundhouse station, best restaurants in the city, the sea wall, and a dog park is just at your front steps.

Comes with 1 parking stall.
